svg.title: LILocBench dynamics_0 verified occupancy map and ground-truth overlay
svg.desc: Dataset map with all 3194 ground-truth poses in known-free cells. Pink line is the recorded trajectory; cyan line is a static four-neighbour A-star path between its first and last cells. Not closed-loop navigation evidence.
svg.metadata: Dataset=LILocBench dynamics_0. Metric=GT path 53.967 m; static A-star 11.200 m, 225 cells, 6891 expansions. Evidence=verified map ingestion and shared-global-frame overlay; not closed loop. Map YAML SHA256=6e61ed85520c2e4638684734c738daf63c17de830a535cd8458cee14cd1fb11e; map image SHA256=8a9ff6aa0d954e7743ed7dd1801d9df2a44a4d023cfda8de6ef12daa39cd57bf; GT SHA256=606f9392c1a992c9acdb5e680a9108ef7647ba8943d747435c90dfa56feaa38f; map archive SHA256=941f96bf90d7d89dddf76fb4864f45212318d39f2b4f1220318786e53f48f6b0. svg.text: Metric: GT path 53.97 m · static A* route 11.20 m · 3194 poses · 6891 A* expansions
Evidence: dataset global-frame provenance + 3194/3194 poses in known-free cells; no fitted transform; not closed loop
